title: Moving to Murfreesboro TN: What to Research Before You Buy
description: Planning on moving to Murfreesboro TN? Check local market data, property taxes, school zoning, commute and closing costs before you make an offer.
body:
If you are moving to Murfreesboro TN, a little research up front saves surprises later. This is a short checklist of what to look into before you make an offer, with the numbers I can stand behind and the official sources for the rest.

One geography note first. Murfreesboro is in Rutherford County. It is not in Williamson County, so county services, taxes and schools follow Rutherford County and the city, not the Franklin side of the line.

## Start with local market numbers

{{img:0}}

National headlines can differ a lot from what is happening in one city. Local figures give you a better read on your own situation.

According to Redfin (rolling 3 months, data as of 2026-10-31), Murfreesboro had a median sale price of $426,703, down 2.5% from a year earlier. Median days on market was 64, the average sale-to-list ratio was 98.7%, and there were 859 active listings.

Redfin also shows 4.5 months of supply. Months of supply is how long it would take to sell every active listing at the current pace of sales. Under 4 months favors sellers, 4 to 6 is balanced, and over 6 favors buyers. For comparison, Redfin reported 5.9 months for the Nashville metro area for the 4 weeks ending 2026-11-08.

These are snapshots, not predictions. Conditions also vary by price range and by neighborhood, so ask for numbers that match the kind of home you want. You can also see [market data for the I-65 corridor](/market-data) and read the [Murfreesboro real estate guide](/murfreesboro).

## Property taxes and schools depend on the address

Two things people often assume are the same across a city are taxes and schools. Neither is.

For the 2026 tax year, inside Murfreesboro city limits, the combined rate is $2.2414 per $100 of assessed value. That is a county rate of $1.4885 and a city rate of $0.7529, according to Rutherford County: Commission approves budget (06/22/2026). These are the rates after the countywide reappraisal, which lowered both. The city rate is the certified figure presented to the City Council on July 2, 2026, so confirm the final adopted number with the City of Murfreesboro.

Tennessee assesses residential property at 25% of appraised value. In words, the tax is the appraised value, times 25%, times the rate, divided by 100. I will skip a sample calculation because your bill depends on the home's actual appraisal and whether it sits inside the city limits. [Rutherford County Government](https://www.rutherfordcountytn.gov) is the place to verify it.

Schools work the same way. Depending on the address, Murfreesboro students attend Murfreesboro City Schools, a district for pre-kindergarten through sixth grade, or Rutherford County Schools. The most reliable way to find the zoned school for a home is to ask each district. Start with [Rutherford County Schools](https://www.rcschools.net), and see the [Murfreesboro school districts](/murfreesboro/schools) page for the overview. Do this for every home you are serious about.

## Build the monthly budget, not just the price

{{img:1}}

A purchase price tells you very little about what living in a home costs each month. Add the payment, taxes, insurance and maintenance, then decide whether that total fits comfortably.

For context, the U.S. Census Bureau (American Community Survey 5-year estimates, 2020 to 2024) lists Murfreesboro's median gross rent at $1,481 per month and median household income at $80,108. It also shows 52.4% of homes as owner-occupied. If you are weighing renting against buying, compare the full monthly cost of owning with the cost of renting a comparable home, and think about how long you expect to stay.

On financing, Freddie Mac via FRED reported a national average 30-year fixed mortgage rate of 7.11% for the week of 2026-11-12. That is a survey average, not a quote, and your own terms will depend on your credit, down payment and loan type. A few things worth knowing:

- Pre-approval means a lender has reviewed your documents and credit. Pre-qualification is a quicker estimate based on what you tell the lender. Neither is a final loan commitment.
- The CFPB encourages getting a Loan Estimate from more than one lender and comparing them, because fees and interest rates can differ by lender. You choose your own lender.
- Conventional loans typically require private mortgage insurance with under 20 percent down. FHA loans allow as little as 3.5 percent down, and VA loans typically require no down payment, though a funding fee may apply.
- Closing costs typically run 2 to 4 percent of the purchase price, plus earnest money and moving costs.

To see how different inputs change a payment, use the [mortgage calculator](/mortgage-calculator). For lending decisions, talk to a licensed lender.

## Check the commute and daily logistics

The Census figure for mean travel time to work in Murfreesboro is 26.7 minutes (ACS 5-year estimates, 2020 to 2024). That is a citywide average and says little about any one address. Test your own route at the hours you would actually drive it. If your plans involve MTSU, whether for work or classes, check that trip too. [TDOT SmartWay](https://smartway.tn.gov) shows current traffic conditions, and the [Murfreesboro commute times](/murfreesboro/commute) page is another place to start.

For utilities, ask which provider serves the address. [Middle Tennessee Electric](https://www.mte.com) is one to check.

Once you have a home in mind, plan for these:

- Ask for the seller's residential property condition disclosure (or exemption). The lead-based paint disclosure applies to homes built before 1978.
- Consider a termite and wood-destroying organism inspection, which buyers and lenders commonly request in Tennessee. Radon testing and a sewer scope are common add-ons to a standard home inspection.
- Do not open new credit, finance furniture or change jobs between applying for a loan and closing.
- Your lender must send the Closing Disclosure at least 3 business days before closing. Compare it with your Loan Estimate and ask questions.
- Verify wire instructions by phone, using a number you already trust. Never rely on emailed instructions.
- Get quotes from at least 3 licensed moving companies, and book early for month-end dates. Our [free moving checklists](/checklists) can help you keep track.

For the broader budget picture, see [Murfreesboro cost of living](/murfreesboro/cost-of-living).

## Next step

If you want help sorting through this for a specific price range or timeline, fill out the [Get matched form](/buy#form). Scott schedules a call, and you will be talking within the next 48 hours. You can also [contact Scott](/contact) with questions first. I am happy to look at the numbers with you, with no pressure.

Use neutral wording, such as asking the seller or the city which providers serve the address, and drop the named provider.
